title: Low-M dense Q4T16 prefill owner band (rows 17-64) retained

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

change.summary: gfx1151 dense Q4T16 prefill selector routes rows 17-64 on the six physical Qwen3.8 standard-Q4 shapes to the 32-thread single-wave WMMA owner (gguf_q4_t16_dense_wmma_prefill_bf16_kernel) instead of LDS-staged shared-B; unadmitted shapes and rows > 64 retain shared-B fail-closed. No registry key, plan selection, or manifest change.
